name: Build, segment and schedule an email campaign in SendGrid
description: Run it with the campaign goal, audience, subject direction, content and send time. An AI agent matches the audience to an existing SendGrid Marketing list and reports its size, picks a verified sender and an unsubscribe group, and drafts the subject, preview text and HTML body. A person reviews the whole package, with the subject and body editable, and only then is the campaign created as a SendGrid Single Send and scheduled for the confirmed time.
shortDescription: Draft a campaign against a real segment and schedule it only after the full package is approved.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the email-campaign-builder skill and an HTTP Client tool for the SendGrid Marketing API
Audience matched to a real list with its size; segments are never guessed
Verified sender and an unsubscribe group required on every send
Approval of audience, content and send time together before anything is scheduled
prerequisites: The `email-campaign-builder` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
HTTP Client Bearer token connection with a SendGrid API key that has Marketing access
A verified sender identity and an unsubscribe group in SendGrid
The audience as an existing SendGrid Marketing list or segment
idealFor: Marketing teams that want campaigns drafted fast without risking a send to the wrong audience.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with the campaign brief.
Draft the campaign: the AI Agent loads the email-campaign-builder skill, resolves the list, sender and unsubscribe group, and drafts the email.
Approve: the run pauses until a reviewer approves audience, content and send time, with the subject and body editable.
Approved: create the SendGrid Single Send and schedule it.
Rejected: log the comment and create nothing.
